messages:
anna: Quick summary from today's GPTQ long-context spotcheck across families (32k context). Ran GPTQ/AWQ/FP16 baselines on instruction + retrieval suites. tl;dr: Llama2-13B + GPTQ-8 with KV-fix looks like the best cost/quality trade. Mistral gets big throughput wins but sees instruction accuracy regressions. Qwen shows a hallucination spike on retrieval workloads; recommend holding AWQ/GPTQ for Qwen until we root-cause.

bharat: Can you drop the notebook/artifact link? want to run a couple of local checks.

eval-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/1719998888/longctx-bake.zip (contains eval logs, config, artifacts)

chen: Can we get the concise metric deltas for MMLU / TruthfulQA / Hallucination-rate? numbers only pls.

anna: Pasted quick table from the run (rounded):
```
Model                          MMLU Δ   TruthfulQA Δ   Hallucination %
Llama2-13B GPTQ-8-kvfix        -0.4%    -0.6%          1.2%
Mistral-7B GPTQ-8              -1.8%    -2.3%          3.8%
Qwen-7B    GPTQ-8              -0.5%    +1.9%          5.6%
FP16 baselines ~ reference (0 deltas)
```

daria: Qwen's hallucination jump on retrieval is worrying — was the context window stitched or chunked? KV-cache ordering bugs can cause this.

anna: We used continuous KV without chunk reordering. Noted a small mismatch in AWQ decode path for Qwen (past-key ordering) — filed runtime ticket #4321 and added a test that reproduces the drift.

bharat: Given that, propose: pin Llama2 -> GPTQ-8-kvfix for Dedicated pools; Mistral -> AWQ for batch (not low-latency) routes; Qwen -> FP16 for retrieval/citational endpoints until #4321 is fixed. Thoughts?

chen: +1. Also suggest adding hallucination checks to the canary suite (sampling retrieval prompts) — we missed that coverage before.

eval-bot: quick canary perf snapshot:
```
Llama2-13B GPTQ-8-kvfix: p95 latency 112ms, throughput 85 tps
Mistral-7B AWQ-8:         p95 latency 78ms,  throughput 140 tps
Qwen-7B FP16:             p95 latency 130ms, throughput 60 tps
```

daria: Action items: anna open rollout PR + include kv-fix tests; bharat run 24h stability on Llama2 GPTQ-8-kvfix in dedicated; chen add retrieval-hallucination checks to canary harness.

anna: On it. I'll tag @eng-runtime and PR in the next 2 hours. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

bharat: 👍

chen: will add the retrieval tests and kick off a small smoke run against canary pool.

daria: leaving a note to ops: avoid mass routing Qwen->GPTQ until #4321 cleared.

eval-bot: scheduled long-run job: s3://redwood-evals/1719998888/longrun.log (24h stability)

anna: Closing thread — will post PR link + rollout matrix once created.
